lessons.title: 日常与居家
lessons.objective: 用简短回答描述日常生活，再补充一个具体细节。
questions: First of all, are you working or studying at the moment?
Is it something you'd choose again?
Is there anything about it you'd change if you could?
Now, your home. Do you live on your own or with other people?
Do most people your age where you live still live with family?
Do you think it matters how big a home is?
aliases: what you do and the home you live in
lessons.addedGuidance: 以友好对话逐题练习原题，从第一个未回答的问题开始。遵循学员档位的语言规则，邀请补充具体细节或原因。不评分，不声称考试结果。跟读属于练习，不是个人偏好。

lessons.title: 食物与烹饪
lessons.objective: 表达饮食喜好，描述一道菜，并解释原因。
questions: Who does most of the cooking in your home?
What is a dish that you can cook well?
Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
Has your taste in food changed since you were a child?

lessons.title: 食品购物
lessons.objective: 描述购买食物的习惯，并比较不同选择。
questions: Where do you usually buy your food?
Do you write a shopping list?
How often do you shop for food?
Do you look at the price first or the quality?
Have you ever bought food online?
